result.summary: This PR changes the importdescriptors RPC to include the full JSON of the failing import request in the error message when a timestamp is missing, instead of a generic 'Missing required timestamp field for key' message. It adds a functional test asserting the new error message format. The author notes it is waiting on PR #34861 to be merged first so this can be rebased or cherry-picked.
result.problem: Users importing multiple descriptors in one importdescriptors call get a generic error when one entry is malformed, making it hard to identify which request failed; this PR adds the offending request's JSON to the error text.
